items.name: Seomara Cube Fest 2024
items.information:
Se vai competir pela primeira vez, certifique-se de ler todas as informações em [Informação Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeomaraCubeFest2024#33011-informacao-importante-important-information), *[ Perguntas Frequentes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LisboaOpen2023#26410-perguntas-frequentes-faq)* e no [Regulamento WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in [Important Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeomaraCubeFest2024#33011-informacao-importante-important-information), the *[FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LisboaOpen2023#26410-perguntas-frequentes-faq)* and the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

**Espectadores podem assistir gratuitamente!/Spectators may attend for free!**

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa0JNIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d2ab52f532a6b40a54a55b58b282d672796dc5af/CubeFest2024.png)

items.name: Elite in Eagan 2024
items.information:
This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association (MCA)](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcDAwIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--9d340df17a1aec4ba42677c10d4db2f31757ffba/image.png)

We have local Facebook groups for our Cubing Area. Feel free to join the [Minnesota Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1798123093777480) and follow the [Midwest Cubing Assocation](https://www.facebook.com/midwestcubing) for information and announcements on upcoming competitions.

items.name: TN Speedsolving Winter 2024
items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TNSpeedsolvingWinter2024#24123-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Join the [Cubing Southeast Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/491409969462797/) to hear about competitions in the Southeast before they're announced and keep in touch with cubers in the area!

This competition is in partnership with Team Nub LLC
![](https://i.imgur.com/vLCf2t9.png)
